race.title: Unibet More Extra Place Races Handicap
race.verdict: CROWN OF CROWNS is a lightly-raced filly who built on debut promise when winning a Southwell novice in October, and whilst she still showed some greenness that day, she's bred to stay well and can make a winning handicap debut. Snooker Mccrew is thriving so is hard to discount, though does have stamina to prove, while Midnight Media looks capable of going well once again. CROWN OF CROWNS SNOOKER MCCREW MIDNIGHT MEDIA
